Login.welcome_description: Your AI coach for League of Legends

CoachStatus.title: Coach Status
CoachStatus.active_desc: AMOKK is active, start a game and he'll begin coaching you!

ConfigurationDialog.assistant_desc: Enable the assistant to ask any question during a game by holding the push-to-talk button.
ConfigurationDialog.ptt_desc: Configure the button to hold to speak to AMOKK once the assistant is enabled.
ConfigurationDialog.ptt_desc2: You can also use this button to interrupt AMOKK by pressing it briefly while he speaks.
ConfigurationDialog.proactive_desc: AMOKK will proactively identify advice opportunities but will still prioritize your questions.

PricingDialog.dialog_desc: Unlock Amokk's full potential with a premium plan
PricingDialog.tryhard_desc: Everything you need to grind and progress quickly!
PricingDialog.rush_desc: For those who want Amokk in every game!

ProgressDialog.card_desc: Discover how Amokk transforms your game
ProgressDialog.dialog_desc: Your ultimate companion to dominate League of Legends
ProgressDialog.why_text: Amokk was created to transform how you learn League of Legends. We know mastering this game can feel overwhelming. That's why we developed a personal AI coach that guides you in real-time.
ProgressDialog.feature1_desc: Understand strengths, weaknesses, and abilities of every champion
ProgressDialog.feature2_desc: Learn how to handle every encounter, when to be aggressive and when to play safe
ProgressDialog.feature3_desc: To get the best advice, you'll learn how to ask AMOKK the right questions
ProgressDialog.feature4_desc: Get advice on positioning, timing, and macro strategies
ProgressDialog.feature5_desc: Identify and fix your mistakes instantly to progress faster
ProgressDialog.feature6_desc: AMOKK tracks the game and explains which item to pick and why
ProgressDialog.feature7_desc: Understand the evolution and dynamics of each game so you never miss a beat
ProgressDialog.cta_text:
Every game with Amokk is an opportunity to get better.
Activate coaching and start your climb!

QuickStartGuide.title: Quick Start Tutorial
QuickStartGuide.step_a_desc: Set your preferences in the settings
QuickStartGuide.step_b_desc: Toggle the switch above to enable coaching
QuickStartGuide.step_c_desc: Just start playing - AMOKK will be there during your games
QuickStartGuide.step_d_desc: Hold push-to-talk for 1 second while AMOKK speaks to interrupt

RemainingGamesCard.games_remaining_desc: Unlock unlimited coaching with a premium plan

Troubleshooting.title: Having an issue?
Troubleshooting.subtitle: Find solutions to common problems
Troubleshooting.solution_1: Ensure League of Legends is running
Troubleshooting.solution_3: Verify AMOKK is set to Active
Troubleshooting.solution_4: Restart the app if problems persist
